statistics.procedure: b-crossed-bootstrap-1: paired crossed two-factor bootstrap implemented by paired_crossed_bootstrap of the frozen statistics module (PROTOCOL_VERSION statistics-1.1, file ed133bb2... in the review copy), official=False: models (training seeds 101-110) x 10 traffic seeds; deterministic comparator broadcast per traffic: D_ij = J_learned(i,j) - J_comparator(j); learned comparator paired by training seed and traffic; synthetic reference results reproduced on Windows before the freeze
statistics.decision_confidence_rule: Bonferroni over the 12 confirmatory contrasts (familywise alpha 0.05): two-sided intervals at exactly 1 - 0.05/12 = 0.99583333...

equivalence_margin.rule: delta_profile = max(0.05 x J_val, 0.10 s), J_val = mean validation J of the profile's primary comparator (B1) from its sealed selection record (R1-R3); for C19 (R0, R4) J_val = 2.765071428571429 s (benchmark_validation 2101-2105, amended freeze, PROTOCOLE_MIN7 2.1); written in margins.json at the freeze

equivalence_margin.idqn_contrasts: the two joint-versus-IDQN contrasts use the declared nominal R0 margin (0.138 s) as a common threshold of practical interest; it is not recomputed from confirmation results

service_units.rule: no interval on pooled evaluations: models and traffics are reused, the evaluations are not independent Bernoulli trials
service_units.reported: for every (profile, method or comparator, arm): evaluations present / expected, events, models with >= 1 event / 10, traffics with >= 1 event / 10; IDQN only on R0 (no expected cell elsewhere)
service_units.intervals: exact Clopper-Pearson, two-sided 95 % and separately one-sided 95 % upper bound, at the model level (10 training seeds as independent draws, conditional on the traffics) and the traffic level (traffics as independent draws, conditional on the models), stratified by profile; a bound on the share of models or traffics with >= 1 event, not a per-vehicle or per-run probability
service_units.not_used: no bootstrap interval of a rate: after zero events it gives [0, 0], which does not establish a zero risk
service_units.status: descriptive; neither interval is a reliability guarantee

members: 10 learned-versus-classical: QMIX with the guarantee and VDN with the guarantee minus the primary comparator of each of the 5 profiles
2 joint-versus-independent on R0: QMIX with the guarantee minus IDQN with the guarantee, VDN with the guarantee minus IDQN with the guarantee
confirmatory_family.tables: the two questions are tabulated separately, with the same global correction displayed
confirmatory_family.replaces: the 99.5 % (Bonferroni over 10) and 97.5 % (Bonferroni over 2) levels of the drafts of 2026-11-19 and 2026-11-23

statistics.bootstrap_assumptions: percentile interval of the crossed two-factor bootstrap: training seeds and traffics are resampled independently with replacement, the whole matrix is re-evaluated; it treats both as exchangeable draws and is an APPROXIMATE large-sample interval, not an exact small-sample guarantee (10 x 10 panel); it cannot use missing cells (a failure makes the contrast not estimable, J is never imputed)

order: SERVICE FAILURE: at least one learned guarantee evaluation of the (profile, method) fails with an open counter wait -> the J comparison is not interpreted as a success; counts reported at the evaluation, model and traffic levels

NOT ESTIMABLE: any other learned failure, or a comparator failure on a traffic (J undefined; never imputed); a descriptive sensitivity without the failing model or traffic is reported, never used for the decision
decision_rules.interval: [L, U] = two-sided crossed-bootstrap interval of the mean difference at 1 - 0.05/12 (family of 12; negative = learned better)
claims_allowed: per profile and method only; no pooling across profiles for a decision

service statement per method: 'no open-wait failure observed in the N guarantee evaluations' only if 0 such failures on the full design, ALWAYS with the counts at the evaluation, model and traffic levels and the unit-level intervals; never stated as a zero risk or as a reliability guarantee (statistics.service_units)
secondary comparisons and the none arm are descriptive (95 %), no decision
the 2 joint-versus-IDQN contrasts are decided within the single family of 12, at the same level; tabulated separately
decision_rules.scope: the service rule and NOT ESTIMABLE apply to the arms of the contrast considered: for a confirmatory contrast under the guarantee, an open-wait failure in a guarantee arm of that contrast gives SERVICE FAILURE, any other failure that prevents the complete contrast gives NOT ESTIMABLE; a failure in a descriptive none arm does not invalidate a confirmatory guarantee contrast
decision_rules.scientific_failure: a correctly recorded clearance failure is a finished observation, never a reason to rerun
decision_rules.technical_block: if any technical control fails (contract, re-read from the traces, identity, hashes), no confirmatory decision is issued

secondary_analyses: guarantee - none on the same model and traffic, per profile and method (QMIX, VDN; IDQN on R0): J over pairs both cleared, D_bar over ALL technically valid pairs (failures included), interventions during and after the demand per arm, present and expected counts
D_bar means and the D_bar differences of the 12 contrasts over all technically valid pairs, failures included (descriptive, 95 %)
each learned arm versus each secondary comparator (95 %, descriptive)
service events: every count per profile, method and arm with the expected count; unit-level intervals (statistics.service_units)

idqn_exclusion.decision: IDQN is NOT in the primary family (learned versus classical comparators). It IS evaluated on the reference scenario, with the guarantee only, for the pre-specified joint-learning contrasts (learned_contrasts; rectificatif of 2026-11-23)
reasons: question: the confirmation tests the cooperative value-factorisation methods (QMIX, VDN) with the guarantee alone; IDQN (independent learners, no coordination) is the non-cooperative reference of the development, ablation and robustness studies, where it is reported in full

known instability before confirmation: in the ablation IDQN is the only method whose minimum-green effect is irregular (improves some models, degrades others; corrects 4 failures, creates 1) and it has 4/50 failures without protection (Clopper-Pearson 95 % [2.2 %, 19.2 %]); in the robustness study the 35 IDQN pairs where the guarantee alone raised D_bar (definition D2) are all in R1 (17) and R2 (18), none in R0 (checked in guarantee_diagnostic/interventions.csv), and the 107/8203 diagnosis shows long opposite greens after interventions: IDQN with the guarantee is not a stable candidate whose result a confirmation could corroborate
multiplicity: adding IDQN would raise the primary family from 10 to 15 comparisons (Bonferroni 99.67 %) and widen every decision interval for a configuration that is not a candidate
consequences: no decision about IDQN versus a classical comparator; its guarantee evaluations on R0 serve only as the independent-learner reference of QMIX - IDQN and VDN - IDQN, and their service events are reported in full
its development, ablation and robustness results are kept and reported in full
declared limitation: the methods confirmed were chosen after the development and robustness results; the confirmation tests them on new traffics

learned_contrasts.question: benefit of joint learning (value factorisation) over independent learners, studied by the manuscript
learned_contrasts.traffics: the 10 confirmation traffics of R0 (8051-8060), the same as QMIX and VDN
learned_contrasts.effect: mean over the 10 training-seed pairs x 10 traffics of D_kj = J_method(k, j) - J_IDQN(k, j), k = training seed number (101-110), j = traffic; negative = the joint learner makes vehicles wait less
learned_contrasts.procedure: paired_crossed_bootstrap with comparator_kind 'learned' (statistics-1.1 convention: pairing by training-seed NUMBER and by traffic; the same seed number does not make two methods' models causally paired, it is the frozen resampling convention), official=False, 10,000 replicates, percentile interval
learned_contrasts.family: the 2 joint-versus-IDQN contrasts are members of the single confirmatory family of 12 (statistics.confirmatory_family); tabulated separately from the 10 learned-versus-classical contrasts
learned_contrasts.multiplicity: members of the single confirmatory family of 12 (statistics.confirmatory_family); decided at 1 - 0.05/12
learned_contrasts.margin: the two joint-versus-IDQN contrasts use the declared nominal R0 margin (0.138 s) as a common threshold of practical interest; it is not recomputed from confirmation results
learned_contrasts.decision_rules: the same rules and order as F1; SERVICE FAILURE if either method of the pair has an open-wait failure under the guarantee; NOT ESTIMABLE if either has any failure
learned_contrasts.claims: per contrast only; a superiority of QMIX or VDN over IDQN on R0 is a statement about the reference scenario, with these 10 models per method, not a general claim
learned_contrasts.conditional_descriptive: also reported: the J difference over the pairs where both runs cleared, with its denominator; descriptive and conditional (excluding failures can change the comparison); J is not replaced by D_bar
learned_contrasts.interpretation: the contrast compares complete methods under the declared protection (training procedure, architecture and guarantee together); on its own it does not prove a causal effect of coordination or of the mixer
learned_contrasts.idqn_none: IDQN without protection on R0: 100 more evaluations, descriptive only

technical_contracts.counter_bound: max service counter <= 127 s in every guarantee arm (counter bound, not a cumulative wait of a vehicle); not imposed on the none arm
technical_contracts.sumo_signals: 0 SUMO signal mismatch (protection_record.json) in every learned arm
technical_contracts.minimum_green: realised shortest green during the demand >= the controller's own minimum: learned 2 s (executor.switch_new_green_s of the frozen config; 5 s decisions with a 3 s yellow), actuated min7 7 s, actuated g5 5 s, canonical max pressure 10 s (frozen executor default, the config has no baselines section); fixed and time-of-day plans: realised greens reported, no realised-minimum contract (a first spell cut by the offset or a period change is not a violation)
technical_contracts.consistency: N, J against tripinfo, logged counters against their recomputation, executor state against the logged phase (robustness_analysis.cell_metrics)
technical_contracts.critical_fields: every field used by a contract or a decision must be present
technical_contracts.re_read: every cell is re-read from its gzip traces; the whole summary and the contracts are recomputed and compared with the stored summary; any difference blocks the confirmatory decisions
technical_contracts.state: a contract violation is a technical failure (state corrupted, preserved, never rerun), never hidden as a scientific clearance failure
